name: Speed Demon makes Suffuse grant 20% movement speed (#1223)
contract: Speed Demon 707232 reads 'Your Suffuse now increases your movement speed by 20%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). Suffuse (801063) claims its previously inert effect index 2 as the native aura 31 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED), targeted at the caster; aura_ascension_xoroth_lifecycle::Calculate (AscensionXorothAuras.cpp) sets that effect's amount to Speed Demon's own tooltip value only while the caster has aura 707232, and to 0 otherwise, so the bonus exists only for the duration Suffuse itself is applied. Speed Demon's own raw effect (a SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 flat modifier targeting the same then-inert slot) is re-tagged SPELL_AURA_DUMMY in ApplyContracts (zeroing the effect type outright, as the original fix did, leaves no valid unit-owned aura effect at all - the same bug class as Murderous Might, 520290 - confirmed empirically: set_aura threw 'Could not apply fixture aura' before this correction). Suffuse is a Spender ability gated on Demonfire (500906) stacks; set_aura forces those stacks directly, matching Chop Shop's (#486) established pattern. Two further gaps found while debugging #1223: (1) Suffuse carries no SpellDuration.dbc entry, so SpellInfo::GetDuration() returns exactly 0 and any aura effect placed on it - including EFFECT_2 - expired in the same tick it was applied; OnCalcMaxDuration (the same global hook already scaling sibling Spender-consumption buff 801064) now gives it 3000ms per Demonfire stack spent. (2) Suffuse had no spell_script_names row binding it to aura_ascension_xoroth_lifecycle at all, so Calculate() never ran for it; a new pending_db_world migration adds that row. Because Calculate() only recomputes an aura's amount when the Aura object is (re)created, not on a same-target refresh of an aura that has not yet expired, the scenario clears the untalented Suffuse application before recasting with Speed Demon known.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: baseline run speed is unmodified
Set Demonfire to the 6-stack cap so Suffuse is castable
SETUP: Suffuse landed without Speed Demon
BASELINE: Suffuse alone does not change movement speed
Force the Speed Demon passive aura
SETUP: the Speed Demon passive is active
Clear the untalented Suffuse application first: a refresh of the still-active aura from the first cast would not recompute EFFECT_2's amount, which is only calculated once at Aura creation
Clear the global cooldown from the first Suffuse cast
Let the fresh Suffuse application recompute its speed effect
SETUP: Suffuse is active with Speed Demon known
CONTRACT: movement speed rises by ~20% while Suffuse is active
